title: pilosella glomerata subsp. cymigeriformis
intro: Pilosella glomerata subsp. cymigeriformis, commonly known as a subspecies of the false hawk's beard plant, is a flowering plant species. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation and gastrointestinal problems, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella glomerata subsp. cymigeriformis include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may aid in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
